_meta.purpose: Canonical seed for platform vertical G-story status rows. The milestone view consumes this registry instead of hardcoded status pills or progress bars; status upgrades are valid only when gate-resolvable evidence is present.

expected_span.full_population_rule: A full registry must contain exactly one row for every id G001 through G013, sorted ascending by id. Seed slices are allowed only for schema/gate bootstrapping and must not be rendered as full platform coverage.

claim_boundary.rendering_rule: Render a row as unverified when status is unverified, evidence_refs are empty, or only local_source_snapshot evidence is present. Do not fall back to reference HTML status pills or numeric bars.
claim_boundary.local_omc_boundary: .omc/ultragoal/goals.json may seed ids/titles/objective summaries for this slice, but it is local workflow provenance and is not sufficient by itself for substantial, complete, or terminal status claims.
claim_boundary.terminal_quality_gate_boundary: G013 session-slice quality-gate passes may prove harness readiness or bounded slice acceptance only. They do not prove full-platform terminal closure unless every upstream G001-G012 vertical has gate-resolvable terminal acceptance evidence and the final integrated-corpus gate is green.

claim_scopes.meaning: A bounded quality-gate run over a named slice or PR train. It can support a claim that the G013 harness exists and passed for that slice, but it cannot set the full G013 platform row to complete or terminal.
claim_scopes.allowed_status_effect: May support an in_progress or substantial claim for harness readiness only when gate-resolvable refs exist; never sufficient for full-platform terminal closure.
required_evidence_inputs: Named slice boundary, including merged PRs or commits covered by the run.
Verified checkout ref or dev head for that slice.
aiSlopCleaner or equivalent deslop verdict for the slice.
Independent verifier result for the slice, including dogfood/smoke/cloud-ci gate subset actually exercised.
Code-review verdict for the slice with reviewer identity and blocker/major counts.
Quality-gate checkpoint or workflow-run reference carrying the cleaner, verifier, and code-review evidence.
Evidence artifact paths under evidence/ when artifacts were produced.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer G001-G012 closure from a slice-quality pass.
Do not promote G013 to complete or terminal from slice evidence alone.
Do not treat local .omc acceptance snippets as gate-resolvable status evidence.

claim_scopes.meaning: The terminal fan-in acceptance gate over the complete integrated G001-G012 platform corpus.
claim_scopes.allowed_status_effect: Required before any G013 complete or terminal claim.
preconditions: Exactly one upstream closure row exists for every id G001 through G012.
Every upstream G001-G012 row has gate-resolvable terminal_acceptance evidence for its own scope.
The final run is performed from a clean checkout of the integrated corpus.
required_evidence_inputs: Upstream closure matrix for G001-G012 with gate-resolvable terminal_acceptance refs.
Final integrated checkout ref or dev head verified by the terminal run.
Full-corpus aiSlopCleaner or equivalent deslop pass.
Independent verifier evidence for dogfood E2E, smoke, and all cloud-ci/oya-ci gates green.
Final code-review APPROVE on the integrated corpus and final PR.
Zero TODO-stub-mock evidence for accepted scope, with the exact search command or gate id recorded.
No hand add/modify evidence for *.generated.json in the accepted diff.
SSH-signed commit evidence for all commits in the accepted diff.
oya-ci-required green on dev or the protected merge-admission head.
Quality-gate-json or checkpoint carrying aiSlopCleaner, verification, and codeReview evidence under evidence/.
claim_scopes.current_source_assessment: The 2026-06-23 status assessment says G013 is deferred until G001-G012 substrates are production-real; historical slice passes are useful harness evidence but not terminal closure.

status_lifecycle.meaning: The G-story row is identified but does not yet have gate-resolvable evidence for a status claim.
status_lifecycle.evidence_requirement: May cite local_source_snapshot for provenance only; dashboard displays unverified.

status_lifecycle.meaning: The vertical is accepted into the registry and has no started implementation evidence.
status_lifecycle.evidence_requirement: Requires a committed planning or sequencing ref that names the vertical.

status_lifecycle.meaning: At least one accepted implementation or gate-evidence ref exists, but terminal acceptance is not present.
status_lifecycle.evidence_requirement: Requires at least one gate-resolvable evidence_ref with claim_role status_support.

status_lifecycle.meaning: Multiple required evidence classes for the vertical are resolved, but the row is not terminally accepted.
status_lifecycle.evidence_requirement: Requires gate-resolvable evidence_refs for the vertical-specific required evidence classes; no numeric progress claim is implied.

status_lifecycle.meaning: The vertical has terminal acceptance evidence for its own scope.
status_lifecycle.evidence_requirement: Requires a gate-resolvable terminal_acceptance ref plus all vertical-specific required evidence classes.

status_lifecycle.meaning: The row is a fan-in/final-quality vertical whose acceptance depends on upstream vertical completion evidence.
status_lifecycle.evidence_requirement: Requires gate-resolvable upstream closure refs and final-quality evidence; no row may infer this from elapsed time, PR state, or a hardcoded snapshot.

gate_expectations.expectation: Parse specs/platform-vertical-status.json as canonical JSON, validate every vertical row against row_json_schema, and reject duplicate ids or unsorted ids.

Reject any row or renderer input containing the forbidden percentage/progress field names. The platform vertical view may derive counts of resolved evidence_refs, but it must not persist or render a claimed completion percentage from this registry.

For status in {in_progress, substantial, complete, terminal}, require at least one evidence_ref with gate_resolvable=true and claim_role=status_support or terminal_acceptance. For substantial, complete, and terminal, local_source_snapshot refs are provenance only and never satisfy the status claim.

When population_mode=seed_slice, consumers must label the registry as partial coverage and must not compute or display full G001-G013 coverage. Full coverage may be claimed only after exactly G001 through G013 are present.

Cross-check source_goal_id and title against the chosen committed platform-vertical source once it exists. Until then, drift against .omc/ultragoal/goals.json is advisory provenance only, not merge authority.
A milestone-view generator must render unverified (no machine SSOT) for missing or unverified rows and must fail if it attempts to import status pills or progress bars from the reference HTML.

For G013, consumers must evaluate terminal_quality_gate_criteria by claim_scope. Slice evidence may identify a bounded quality-gate pass, but complete or terminal claims require all full_platform_terminal_closure required_evidence_inputs plus gate-resolvable upstream terminal_acceptance refs for every G001-G012 row.

verticals.title: G01 Contract Lock + Authority Reconciliation
verticals.objective_summary: Serialized fan-out unlock. Fix stale authority surfaces, author hyperscaler decision-matrix ADRs, and lock shared contract seeds before PR to dev with oya-ci-required green.

evidence_refs.notes: Seeds id/title/objective only; does not satisfy complete status.

gate_required_before_claim: Replace local_source_snapshot-only provenance with committed, gate-resolvable terminal evidence before claiming complete.
Keep the row free of completion-percent or progress-bar fields.

verticals.title: G11 Pipeline-as-Product Ratchet
verticals.objective_summary: Continuous lane. Close the Buck-only gate-registration blind spot, migrate oya-check-* and oya-dev-cli gate logic into oya-cloud-ci-discipline-app crates, and convert every friction into a gate or automation.

evidence_refs.notes: Seeds id/title/objective only; does not satisfy in_progress or substantial status.

gate_required_before_claim: Add at least one committed, gate-resolvable status_support ref before claiming in_progress.
Require terminal_acceptance evidence before any complete or terminal claim.

verticals.title: G13 Final Quality Gate
verticals.objective_summary: Serialized fan-in final quality gate: deslop pass, independent verifier, dogfood E2E, smoke, cloud-ci gate evidence, final review approval, generated-file and TODO/stub/mock hygiene, signed commits, and oya-ci-required green over the accepted platform scope.

evidence_refs.notes: Seeds id/title/objective and records historical session-slice acceptance snippets only; not terminal full-platform evidence.
Assessment says G013 remains a deferred terminal gate until G001-G012 substrates are production-real; historical slice passes are harness evidence only.

gate_required_before_claim: Classify each evidence ref under terminal_quality_gate_criteria claim_scope before using it for status.
Session-slice quality-gate passes require the session-slice evidence inputs and may not promote this row to complete or terminal.
Full-platform terminal closure requires every full_platform_terminal_closure evidence input plus upstream terminal_acceptance refs for G001 through G012.
Keep the row free of completion-percent or progress-bar fields.
